CODE
Art. 2.3.56. 
Unequal division and attribution clause 
The spouses may agree that the surviving spouse, or one of them if he or she survives, shall receive a share other than half, or even all, of the patrimony at the time of division.   
Where the spouses receive unequal shares in the partition of the joint estate, they are obliged to contribute to the payment of the joint debts in proportion to their share of the assets, without prejudice to the application of Article 2.3.50, ¤ 2.
In the absence of any other provision in the deed of partition, a spouse who, after the partition, pays a joint debt in excess of his or her share under paragraph 2 has recourse against the other spouse for what he or she has paid in excess of his or her share.
